changes.comment: A dispatcher's shutdown stops Workflows, each Team, each materialized TeamMate runtime, and the dispatcher's own Agent runtime, joins every already-admitted operation, then repeats that same runtime sweep once more before closing Channels last. The sweep runs before the admitted-work join as well as after: an admitted call can itself be starting a runtime with no timeout of its own, so joining first would wait on exactly the runtime the sweep exists to stop, and stopping it first is what makes that runtime's own teardown unblock the join. The second, post-join pass catches a pre-fence admission that only starts - or, since a runtime stop fences an entity's admission for its own convergence only and never durably closes it, revives - a runtime after the first pass already read past that entity. Separately, TeammateCollection's and TeamCollection's own entity-construction paths check the dispatcher's closing fact the instant they register a brand-new entity and self-close its runtime immediately, preempting a spawned TeamMate's first submission outright (a Team's leader can already have taken its first prompt by the time the collection notices, so it only stops that runtime as soon as it can) - a different race, from a new entity's own construction, than the two-pass sweep covers.
